Paper Name: Hybrid off-grid energy systems optimal sizing with integrated hydrogen storage based on deterministic balance approach
NOTES: Primary optimal system (Case 2 - PV/WT/FC/ELZ/H2) selected for Cairo International Airport. Case 1 (PV/FC/ELZ/H2, no wind): NPV=5400 panels (5400x0.335kW=1809kW total), FC=300kW, ELZ=800kW+1000kW (2 units), H2 tank=100kg, LCOE=0.247 $/kWh. Case 2 (optimal): PV+WT+FC+ELZ+H2, LCOE=0.2116 $/kWh, PV capital=$1,340,000, WT=250kW capital=$250,000, FC=250kW capital=$750,000, ELZ=300kW capital=$960,000, H2 tank=100kg capital=$2000. Total production: PV contributes 76.2%, FC 23.8% (748,235 kWh/year). Annual AC primary load=1,582,615 kWh/year (58% of production). ELZ consumes 1,063,082 kWh/year (42%). Unmet demand=235,003 kWh/year. Excess=366,370 kWh/year. 100% renewable fraction. Inferred PV capacity Case 2: ~447kW using $3000/kW reference, but actual PV kW not explicitly stated. N_PV count not given for Case 2. WT count not explicitly stated (sensitivity varies 250-750kW in 250kW steps). Diesel generator NOT used in optimal config. H2 production ~2000kg/year. Inferred annual load from HOMER: 1,582,615 kWh. LPSP not explicitly stated but unmet demand implies ~15% annual unmet.
